explanation: The theorem says that the image of the library's own map `toGL`, from the Steinberg group to the general linear group, is the elementary subgroup. The result rests on the library's own definitions and on its lemma `toElementary_surjective`. I searched the Mathlib sources for "Steinberg" and found no matches, so Mathlib has no Steinberg group and no counterpart of this map. Mathlib therefore cannot contain this result.
